description: A null condition after an unknown one gives the dynamic value instead of an error
notes: The spec doesn't say whether a null condition is an error (native/for/condition-null-is-error), and says unknown values give the dynamic pseudo-type only when they are otherwise type-valid. hashicorp/hcl reports a null condition otherwise, but ForExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) only reports it while every earlier condition was known, so after an unknown condition it skips the error and returns the dynamic value.
